query: I have this AsyncAPI spec at `evals/fixtures/pricing.asyncapi.yaml`. Write Drift tests for the `requestPriceQuote` operation.
expected_behavior: Triggers the asyncapi-parser skill to handle spec analysis
Identifies the operation action as 'send' with a reply block present and determines the execution mode as async-request-reply
Produces an analysis section stating: 1 operation, action: send + reply, mode: async-request-reply, 1 test variant
Generates exactly one Drift operation named RequestPriceQuote_SendReceive (or similar)
The operation has NO trigger block — Drift is the publisher for async-request-reply
The target names the REQUEST operation/message: <source>:requestPriceQuote:priceQuoteRequest
parameters includes correlation-id, timeout-ms, and payload with requestType: price.quote, sku, and quantity
The expected block describes the REPLY message (payload + headers), not the request — it includes responseType, sku, quantity, quotedUnitPrice, quotedTotalPrice, currency, availability
